title: Wynwood rooftop watch
scene: Night above Miami's Wynwood murals and boutique rooftops. A.V. watches shadow figures gather on the street below.
objective: Spot a safe route to the next rooftop

title: Pearl of Destiny approach
scene: A.V. drives through Wynwood's art district toward the building holding her next mission clue.

title: Balcony ambush
scene: On a South Beach apartment balcony, A.V. faces masked shadow soldiers while green-and-yellow-suited Emerald Onyx arrives to help.
objective: Hold the balcony and protect the mission package

title: Wynwood Walls defense
scene: Shadow soldiers advance through a mural-lined street while civilians retreat behind A.V.
objective: Keep the civilian escape route open

title: Rooftop crossing
scene: A.V. crosses low rooftop gaps above colorful Wynwood storefronts as distant shadow snipers watch.

title: Miami Shadow Warlock
scene: On a high Miami rooftop, A.V. faces a Shadow Warlock surrounded by dark energy, city lights visible behind them.
objective: Disrupt one of the Warlock's shields

title: Flying car extraction
scene: A futuristic drone car descends toward A.V.'s rooftop extraction point as dawn lights the coastline.
objective: Reach the vehicle with the recovered package

title: Frankfurt after dark
scene: Green-skinned Germani, the Ivy Moon Queen, enters a rain-lit Frankfurt street under moonlight. Protective ivy curls around her wrist.

title: Artifact escort
scene: Germani carries a sealed mystical artifact through a narrow Frankfurt passage as shadow scouts emerge.
objective: Deliver the artifact to the safe entrance

title: Ivy barrier
scene: Germani raises luminous green ivy to shield an alley entrance against shadow soldiers.
objective: Maintain the barrier until allies escape

title: Moonlit extraction
scene: Germani approaches a moonlit portal on a Frankfurt rooftop while black vines threaten the surrounding masonry.
